void Rte_Init_<InitContainer>(void) Where <InitContainer> is the short name of the RteInitializationRunnableBatch container.
An Rte_Init API shall be created for each RteInitializationRunnableBatch container.

An Rte_Init API shall invoke the RunnableEntitys which are associated with an RTEEvent mapped to the related RteInitializationRunnableBatch container in the order defined by the RtePositionInTask parameters.
Rte_Init shall return within finite execution time – it must not enter an infinite loop.
Rte_Init shall be implemented as a function.
An Rte_StartTiming API shall be created if any Rte_Init API is created.
Rte_StartTiming API shall release the activation of RunnableEntitys triggered by TimingEvents and BackgroundEvents.
Rte_StartTiming shall return within finite execution time – it must not enter an infinite loop.
